About Addi
We are a leading financial platform, building the future of payments, shopping, and banking—a world where consumers and merchants can transact effortlessly and grow together. Today, we serve over 3.6 million customers and partner with more than 55,000 merchants, making Addi Colombia’s fastest-growing marketplace.
With a state-of-the-art, technology-first approach, we provide banking solutions (deposits, payments, unsecured credit) and commerce services (e-commerce, marketing), bridging the financial gap for millions and redefining how people experience financial freedom.

As the country’s leading Buy Now, Pay Later provider, we have secured regulatory approval to operate as a bank, unlocking even greater opportunities for our customers. In the past year, we have also achieved profitability, reinforcing the strength of our business model and our ability to scale sustainably.
Our mission has earned the trust of world-class investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Architect Capital, GIC, Goldman Sachs, Greycroft, Monashees, Notable Capital, Quona Capital, Union Square Ventures, Victory Park Capital, and more, who back our vision for the future. With their support, we are not just growing—we are transforming Latin America’s financial ecosystem and shaping the next generation to shop, pay, and bank in Colombia.
But what truly sets us apart is how we build. We are a conscious company, driven by deep experience in scaling technology, services and products, and we live by our values every day.

This is where you come in. Below, you’ll find what this role is all about—the impact you’ll drive, the challenges you’ll tackle, and what it takes to thrive at Addi. If you’re ready to be part of something big, keep reading.
What’s the mission you’ll drive
Lead Addi’s B2B Marketing function as an AI-first operating system, driving merchant GMV growth by scaling the Activation and Growth Playbook (PAC) end-to-end. This role unifies B2B merchant activation with Consumer CRM amplification while architecting a fully automated, agentic, and data-driven growth infrastructure to maximize commercial output per FTE.

Deploy a Tiered PAC Framework: Design and operationalize a three-tier PAC model (Premium, Standard, Base) by Q3, driving measurable merchant growth and increased participation across strategic accounts.
Launch Merchant Performance Media: Build the paid media function from scratch, launching the first wave of co-campaigns in Q3 and shipping a centralized playbook with merchant-facing ROI reporting by Q4.
Stand up the Merchant Lifecycle CRM: Architect and launch the merchant onboarding, activation, and retention journeys in Salesforce, deploying the foundational layer by Q3 and full lifecycle orchestration by Q4.
Unify the B2B–Consumer Loop: Integrate quarterly PAC planning with the Consumer CRM team by Q3, establishing an automated "B2B Deal → Targeted CRM Amplification → Unified Attribution" feedback loop.
Strengthen Marketing-Sales Alignment: Establish a formal marketing-to-sales handoff with the commercial team by Q4, increasing collaboration, pipeline visibility, and engagement across priority accounts.
Build an AI-First Operating System: Deploy production-ready AI agents to support key marketing workflows, including account research, content creation, and CRM journey quality assurance.

Proven Track Record in B2B & Merchant Marketing at Scale (MUST HAVE)
Demonstrates +6 years of B2B marketing leadership in fast-scaling environments, with deep specialization in marketplace, BNPL, or retail platform ecosystems.
Mastered the design of complex co-marketing models, joint-investment economics, and partner attribution structures.
Translates commercial priorities directly into revenue-generating programs rather than just asset production.

s.h: Operates as an AI-First Marketer & Systems Architect (MUST HAVE)
s.t:
Deeply technical and hands-on with prompt engineering, agentic frameworks (e.g., Claude agents, LangGraph), and model selection trade-offs.
Applies an explicit "AI as headcount" lens to team design, evaluating every new workflow for automation viability before posting a human opening.
Demonstrates at least one live, measurable example of using production AI agents to compound B2B marketing throughput.
Possesses Strong CRM Architecture & Salesforce Mastery (MUST HAVE)
Experienced in building B2B lifecycle infrastructure (onboarding, activation, retention, expansion) from the ground up on Salesforce.
Controls complex data models, audience segmentation, journey logic, and multi-channel orchestration.
Track Record of Commercial Fluency & Sales Partnership (MUST HAVE)
Speaks fluent pipeline metrics, deal velocity, ICP criteria, and account tiering alongside commercial teams.
Direct experience being measured on hard B2B funnel contributions (opportunities sourced/influenced, pipeline acceleration).
Demonstrates Excellence in Performance Media & Attribution (MUST HAVE)
Hands-on mastery of scaling paid media channels (Meta, LinkedIn, programmatic, in-app) for targeted B2B or co-op merchant audiences.
Defends and refines complex incrementality and attribution models directly with merchant partners to prove ROI.
Proven Capability in Brand Building & B2B Storytelling (PREFERRED)
Strong instinct for category creation, thought leadership, and shaping ecosystem narrative through proprietary flagship moments.
Experienced in Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence (PREFERRED)
Navigates multi-sided business loops and influences matrixed stakeholders across Product, Risk, Legal, and Consumer squads.

Work on a problem that truly matters – We are redefining how people shop, pay, and bank in Colombia, breaking down financial barriers and empowering millions. Your work will directly impact customers' lives by creating more accessible, seamless, and fair financial services.
Be part of something big from the ground up – This is your chance to help shape a company, influencing everything from our technology and strategy to our culture and values. You won’t just be an employee—you’ll be an owner
Unparalleled growth opportunity – The market we’re tackling is massive, and we’re growing faster than almost any fintech lender at our stage. If you’re looking for a high-impact role in a company that’s scaling fast, this is it.
Join a world-class team – Work alongside top-tier talent from around the world, in an environment where excellence, ownership, and collaboration are at the core of everything we do. We care deeply about what we build and how we build it—and we want you to be a part of it.
Competitive compensation & meaningful ownership – We believe in rewarding our talent. You’ll receive a generous salary, equity in the company, and benefits that go beyond the basics to support your growth.
How the hiring process looks like
We believe in a fast, transparent, and engaging hiring experience that allows both you and us to determine if there's a great fit. Here’s what our process looks like:
Step 1: People Interview (30 min)
A conversation with a recruiter to get to know you, your experience, and what you're looking for. We’ll also share more about Addi, our culture, and the role.

The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments as well as other OpenAI products worldwide. We operate across the full funnel - from awareness and acquisition through activation, retention, and expansion - using a combination of global performance marketing, AI-powered workflows, in-product optimization, insights, experimentation, and creative ops engineering.

We are hiring a Growth Marketing Manager to turn product-led growth priorities into clear audience strategies, compelling cross-channel messaging, coordinated go-to-market programs, and drive measurable, incremental growth.
You will partner closely with Growth Product, Consumer Product Marketing, Lifecycle, Performance Marketing, Brand, Creative, Research, Data Science, and International Marketing to ensure that full-funnel campaigns and initiatives are supported and connected to Growth capabilities and maximize the performance of these campaigns.

Build the marketing layer across the Growth roadmap: acquisition, access, activation and resurrection, monetization, and the shared Growth Platform.
Translate product hypotheses into audience insights, positioning, messaging, launch briefs, lifecycle journeys, landing-page narratives, performance creative, and in-product education.
Maintain an integrated plan that connects the Growth product roadmap to the consumer product marketing calendar across lifecycle, performance, social, creators, partnerships, and brand moments.
Serve as the subject matter expert across all Growth levers, advising teams across the organization on the most effective ways to integrate Growth into their initiatives.
Partner with cross-functional teams to design and interrogate the user journey so we can align our external promises with in-product and owned-channel landing, access, onboarding, continuation, and conversion experiences.
Create audience and market playbooks for new users, high-value, or at-risk cohorts, including where acquisition headroom, access friction, weak Week 1 continuation, churn, or monetization gaps are greatest.
Turn campaign, lifecycle, research, and product data into clear readouts that improve both marketing execution and future product prioritization.
Use AI-enabled workflows to increase research, synthesis, briefing, and iteration speed while maintaining judgment, quality, and user trust.

s.h: You might thrive in this role if you have
s.t:
5+ years of experience in product marketing, growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, consumer marketing, or a related role; equivalent project experience is welcome.
Evidence that you can turn customer or market insight into clear positioning, messaging, and practical execution.
Experience supporting a launch, onboarding journey, lifecycle program, conversion initiative, or growth experiment and learning from the results.
Comfort working with funnels, cohorts, experiments, and metrics—and knowing when the data does not prove causality.
Strong cross-functional execution skills and the ability to keep owners, decisions, dependencies, and next steps clear.
Clear, concise writing and the judgment to adapt one strategic narrative across product surfaces and marketing channels.
A hands-on operating style: you can structure an ambiguous problem, produce the work, and ask for help at the right moments.

About Supercell
Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars . Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.
So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings , and killing lots of projects.
Hey, You Might Love It Here!
Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture . But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.
You Are Not Your Job Title ™
Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.
Relocation? Yes!
No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!
Not Sure if You Should Apply?
Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.
Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

s.h: As a Senior Marketing Manager, Web Growth, you'll
s.t:
Own web optimization and A/B testing in partnership with the demand-gen team. Run a structured, high-velocity experimentation program on webflow.com — hypothesis to live test to statistically valid result — using our experimentation and personalization stack (Webflow Optimize and equivalents). Set the test roadmap, defend statistical rigor, and turn win rate and conversion lift into reported KPIs, not anecdotes.
Own the web-side execution of AEO in partnership with the AEO lead. The AEO lead owns methodology, measurement, and category strategy; you own what makes webflow.com win citations and manage site performance improvements, accessibility, site architecture best practices.
You are the AEO lead's trusted site-side partner — the one who turns their strategy into live citation wins on webflow.com.
Run webflow.com as a "living" website, not a project that ships and stops. Own the continuous development of the site — page and component build, design QA, performance, and iteration velocity — so the site is always evolving in-platform. This is the customer-zero narrative made real: Webflow on Webflow, demonstrated through webflow.com, built and optimized on our own product every day.
Turn webflow.com into an account-level pipeline engine. Lead the on-brand experimentation, personalization stack, and conversion architecture that converts ICP-matched traffic into qualified pipeline. Partner closely with Demand Gen to ensure web experiences reflect and reinforce active sales-led pipeline initiatives (ABM target accounts, named-account journeys, and campaign-specific landing experiences).
Build and ship,beyond building briefs. Design, build, and ship landing pages and site experiences end to end in-platform — you're hands-on in the product, closing the loop from hypothesis to live page yourself rather than handing specs to a queue. Own the web measurement layer. Instrument event tracking, funnel analytics, and attribution for site-sourced pipeline so every experiment and every AEO/answer-engine visit is measurable end to end — and so web's contribution to pipeline is provable, not asserted. Support campaign orchestration across the web as a channel. You don't own or operate the orchestration engine — you represent webflow.com as a coordinated channel within it.

Wire site behavior signals and on-site responses into the cross-channel play, and execute the web slice of an orchestrated account motion so a single account signal (AEO citation, site behavior, paid engagement) triggers a coordinated web response, not a siloed one.

Ship and iterate. You'd rather run ten disciplined tests than debate one perfect page. You have a bias toward getting a valid experiment live this week, and a hypothesis-first instinct for what to test next.
Are technically fluent enough to be dangerous. You can read a Marketo trigger, sanity-check a schema markup change, QA a page built in Webflow, and interpret a Tableau attribution model without a translator. You partner with GTM Engineering as a peer, not a customer.
Distinguish signal from noise in intent data. You know why a hand-raiser can convert dramatically better than a LinkedIn lead, and you build campaign design around that reality.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff.

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place.

Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The B2B Marketing Team is a critical driver of growth for Square. This role is to lead a small but mighty team to drive growth for the Japanese market. Your role will drive growth through supporting our sales GTM motions, including telesales, field sales, resellers, and partnerships.
You will ensure excellent execution against different channels such as events, social, content marketing, media and partnerships. In this role, you won't just manage campaigns, you will own our search portfolio's evolution. You will be responsible for moving beyond traditional lead-gen metrics to implement advanced Value-Based Bidding (VBB) models that align search spend directly with downstream pipeline value.

Leveraging cutting-edge AI capabilities and robust statistical testing, you will maintain complete visibility over all in-market campaigns, ensuring every dollar spent is backed by data and optimized for maximum business impact.

Value-Based Strategy & Execution: Develop and execute comprehensive, AI-driven paid search strategies across Google Ads and Bing Ads. Lead the transition to and optimization of Value-Based Bidding (VBB) models to prioritize high-value pipeline and revenue over raw lead volume.

Martech & Data Integration: Collaborate closely with Marketing Operations and Digital Analytics teams to ensure seamless integration with CRM platforms (Salesforce) and marketing automation (Marketo). Ensure accurate offline conversion tracking (OCT) to feed VBB algorithms high-quality feedback loops.
Audience & Competitive Intelligence: Conduct advanced keyword research, competitive benchmarking, and first/third-party audience segmentation to identify high-intent targeting opportunities.
Process Automation: Identify opportunities for workflow automation, scripting, and process improvement to increase operational efficiency and scale our search program.
Account Hygiene & Automation: Actively audit account architecture to eliminate query bleeding and campaign cannibalization. Identify opportunities for workflow automation, scripting, and process improvement to scale our search program cleanly.

Education: BA or BS in Marketing, Business, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related analytical field.
Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing enterprise-level, full-funnel paid search campaigns, media planning, and advanced measurement.
Analytical Rigor: Exceptional analytical skills with a proven track record of using statistical significance models to validate test results and drive data-backed decisions.
VBB Expertise: Strong experience implementing and optimizing Value-Based Bidding (VBB) and offline conversion feedback loops (connecting CRM data back to ad platforms).
AI Literacy: Practical experience leveraging AI-driven search features, automated bidding algorithms, and predictive analytics tools to scale and optimize campaigns.
Martech Proficiency: Deep expertise in Google Ads, Bing Ads, Salesforce (CRM), Marketo/Eloqua (Marketing Automation), and advanced web analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GTM, or equivalent).
Project Management & Communication: Strong project management skills with the ability to translate complex, multi-layered data points into clear, concise, and actionable insights for cross-functional stakeholders.
B2B Context: Prior experience in B2B SaaS marketing is highly preferred.

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:
This role owns paid search at Mews end to end, across every market we operate in. Paid search is one of our core acquisition channels, so the strategy, the budget decisions, and the performance against target all sit with one person rather than being split across an agency and a manager above them. The environment is genuinely complex: multiple markets, multiple languages, and a commercial motion running from small independent properties through to enterprise hotel groups.
You will set the direction and define what good looks like across those markets, then back every move with data. Day to day you will work closely with Data, Measurement, Finance, Brand, and Regional Marketing, which means search activity gets tied to real commercial priorities rather than optimised in isolation. Hospitality tech is a fast-moving category with unusual search behaviour across regions, and the person in this seat has the room to shape how Mews shows up in it.
What you would do
Own paid search strategy across all Mews markets: planning, execution, optimisation, testing, and reporting.
Hold performance against acquisition, revenue, ROI, and efficiency targets, and make the budget calls that follow.
Work with Product Marketing, Brand, Data, Finance, and Regional Marketing to align search activity with commercial priorities.
Build AI-assisted workflows into how search gets run here: query and creative analysis, ad copy generation and testing at scale, anomaly detection across markets, and documenting those workflows so the wider marketing team can use them.
Manage agency and platform relationships, and find growth through experimentation, automation, and new platform capabilities.
AI Fluency Level 3: in this role that means you have already changed how paid search work gets done, not just sped up your own tasks. You have built something repeatable, whether that is an AI-assisted process for keyword and query mining, creative iteration, or performance anomaly review, and handed it to others in a form they can actually run.

It also means you check what the model gives you. When AI proposes a bid change, a negative keyword list, or a read on why CAC moved, you know how to test that claim against the data before it reaches a live budget.
For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence.
What you would bring
Deep working knowledge of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads: bidding strategies, attribution, conversion tracking, and web measurement are things you know well, not things you are still learning.
A clear record of improving paid search performance against measurable targets such as acquisition volume, CAC, or ROI.
Comfort with large datasets and the quantitative judgement to turn them into sound commercial decisions.
Experience with reporting and visualisation tools such as GA4, Looker, Tableau, or SQL, plus a solid grasp of measurement and experimentation methodology.
AI Fluency Level 3, or the equivalent hands-on experience applying AI to paid search or performance marketing work.

Experience with scripts or AI-enabled optimisation techniques applied directly to paid search.
Multi-market or multi-language campaign experience.
Exposure to a commercial motion spanning SMB through enterprise.

About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Ramp is building new products that can reshape how finance teams operate. These products begin before the market playbook is obvious: the customer problem is still being sharpened, the product is evolving quickly, and the path from early signal to durable growth must be built.
We are hiring a Product Marketing Manager, New Products to lead that work. You will be embedded with Product and Engineering from the earliest stages, using customer and market insight to help choose the audience, shape the product, define the story, and build the commercialization and adoption motion.
This is not a launch-calendar or asset-production role. You will own the full business read for the product: customer problem, ICP, positioning, product readiness, launch, pipeline, activation, adoption, retention, proof, and the next product or GTM intervention.

Shape product strategy early. Bring customer, market, and competitive evidence into product decisions before the roadmap is fixed. Help the team identify the wedge, target segment, table stakes, differentiators, and highest-leverage problems to solve.
Find product-market clarity. Define the ICP, buyer, user, jobs to be done, workflow, alternatives, and reasons customers will switch or expand.
Own the product narrative. Build the canonical positioning, messaging, claims, proof, and competitive story. Translate technical and operational complexity into a clear customer value proposition without flattening how the product works.
Design the zero-to-one GTM. Determine how the product should enter the market, including audience, channel, pricing and packaging inputs, sales motion, self-serve motion, launch sequence, and adoption plan.
Lead launches end to end. Coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Growth, Creative, Communications, Support, and other partners around one launch strategy, readiness bar, and set of measurable outcomes.
Build commercialization, not just awareness. Create the programs, enablement, proof, and feedback loops that turn interest into qualified pipeline, activation, retained usage, expansion, and revenue.
Work deeply with Product and Engineering. Understand the product's architecture, data, constraints, and trust model well enough to influence tradeoffs and explain it credibly to both technical and business audiences.
Create the customer learning system. Develop direct relationships with buyers and users, run structured discovery, capture objections and product gaps, and turn what you learn into product and GTM decisions.
Own the business scorecard. Define leading and lagging indicators, build a clear operating read, diagnose what is moving or stuck, and recommend the next intervention.
Build proof and competitive intelligence. Develop customer evidence, use cases, benchmarks, and a current view of the market that improve both product decisions and GTM execution.
Use AI as an operating advantage. Apply AI to research, synthesis, analysis, content development, and repeatable workflows—and help the team raise its standard for speed and quality.
Create the new-products playbook. Build a repeatable method for taking an emerging product from customer signal to product-market clarity, launch, commercialization, and scaled growth.
What you'll need
6+ years of experience in B2B software product marketing, product management, growth, strategy, or another product-led GTM function, including significant ownership of a product or business outcome.
Demonstrated zero-to-one experience with a new product, category, platform, or business line—from early customer discovery through launch and adoption.
A record of influencing product strategy using customer, market, competitive, and performance evidence.
Strong customer instincts. You can run discovery, identify the real workflow and buying problem, and separate a loud request from a durable market signal.
Technical and operational fluency. You can learn a complex product, work credibly with Product and Engineering, and explain how it works to different audiences.
Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can produce a sharp product narrative, an executive recommendation, a launch plan, and a sales story that survives contact with customers.
Strong data literacy. You can define and interpret activation, adoption, retention, pipeline, conversion, revenue, and product-usage metrics and turn the findings into a decision.
Proven ability to lead senior partners across Product, Engineering, Sales, Growth, Creative, and Marketing without relying on formal authority.
High agency and comfort with ambiguity. You build the first version, test it with customers, make tradeoffs, and improve it quickly.
Fluency with AI tools as part of your everyday research, analysis, writing, and operating workflows.

Experience in fintech, payments, accounts receivable, accounting, developer tools, data infrastructure, AI, or another technical and workflow-heavy category.
Experience taking a product from incubation through product-market fit and scaled commercialization.
Experience with both product-led and sales-led growth motions.
Experience contributing to pricing and packaging decisions.
Experience as an early or founding PMM, product manager, founder, or operator in a fast-moving product area.

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.
For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.
AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.
At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience.

But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.
We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.
Check out our principles to see how we work.

This is a partner marketing role that demands product marketing craft. You'll be the single-threaded owner of how every Claude launch lands on partner marketing surfaces. We reach many of our most important customers through our partners.

Model and capabilities launches are the core of the job and the majority of the work. Small business owners didn't start their business to become their own bookkeeper, banker, and collections department. Jobber is changing that, building the financial hub for a $400B home-services market, and Fintech is how we get there.
The future of financial services is embedded, and we're still early. For decades, small businesses ran their finances through a patchwork: a bank for payments, a lender for capital, a spreadsheet for everything else. That's ending. The next generation of financial services won't live at a bank, it'll live inside the software businesses already use to run their day. More and more, vertical SaaS platforms like Jobber won't just help small businesses operate; they'll become their financial hub.
Jobber is building for that world. We already help home service pros get paid faster, secure the capital they need to grow, and see their financial health clearly, and we've only scratched the surface. We're looking for a Senior Manager, Product Marketing (Fintech) to own the commercial story that gets us there, as part of our growing Product & Lifecycle Marketing team.
Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists.

With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011, but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers .

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect from time to time. This role is open to candidates anywhere in Canada. Employees who live in one of our hub cities - Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo will participate in their department's in-office schedule, while employees outside our hub cities will work remotely.

At Jobber, we're not just building software, we're helping home service businesses accelerate revenue growth, improve profitability, and maintain healthy cash flow. Our Product Marketing Fintech team is central to this mission: enabling businesses to get paid faster, secure the capital needed for growth, and gain clarity on their financial health.

This is not a launch-execution role. Reporting to our Senior Director, Product & Lifecycle Marketing, you'll own Marketing-influenced revenue for Jobber's entire Fintech portfolio; adoption, activation, usage, and revenue across payments, financing, and capital are your numbers.

It's a career-defining opportunity to lead the adoption of Fintech in one of the largest remaining B2B markets, partner with the best-of-the-best in the space, and help small businesses succeed while you do it. If you think like a business owner and want to lead a team that moves the needle on revenue, this is the role.

Lead and develop the team: Coach and grow a team of Product Marketers and Lifecycle Marketers across payments, consumer financing, lending, and new products, building an inclusive, high-performing culture that values learning, accountability, and collaboration, and supporting career growth through regular coaching and feedback.

Evaluate industry events, sponsorships, and speaking opportunities to recommend participation based on strategic value and expected ROI.

Identify opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency, and scale the event program.

3-5 years of experience in B2B event marketing, field marketing, or integrated marketing.
Experience planning and executing trade shows, conferences, customer events, or similar marketing programs.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and budget expectations.

Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Excel and PowerPoint.

Strong business acumen with an understanding of how events contribute to marketing and revenue objectives.
Strategic thinker with excellent project management and organizational skills.
Ability to analyze data and use insights to improve marketing performance.
Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills.
Proven ability to influence and collaborate across cross-functional teams.
Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
Resourceful, proactive, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.
High attention to detail with a commitment to delivering exceptional experiences.
Self-starter who takes ownership and drives projects to completion.

This role is built for an experimenter and builder. You will have the freedom to test new channels, messages, technologies, and account plays, learn quickly from performance, and scale the approaches that deliver results. You will help Dropbox strengthen its ABM motion by bringing together personalized experiences, product-led growth signals, and coordinated Sales engagement.
You will join Dropbox at an important moment in the evolution of our sales-led growth strategy. We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join Joist AI and become a vital bridge between our product and go-to-market teams. In this role, you'll be embedded directly in the Product teams to help shape the strategy to drive business objectives. You’ll translate complex innovation into compelling narratives that champion the customer and focus on value to make a real impact on the business.
As a core member of our marketing team, you'll work hand-in-hand with Product Management to shape how we bring new features to market, ensure our teams are armed with the knowledge they need to succeed, and empower customers to adopt and grow with our product. You'll be the "eyes and ears" of GTM—making sure everyone knows what is being built, when, and why it matters–and the “megaphone” for the PM team, making sure that we maximize product investments for the business.

Product Expertise & Collaboration
Reinforce product-market fit through daily collaboration with Product Managers on new features and enhancements, in partnership with PMM leadership & marketing peers
Become the master product SME for the GTM organization, deeply understanding PM goals, priorities, and challenges
Serve as the connective tissue between product development and go-to-market execution
Launch Excellence
Own the product launch process from planning through execution, driving cross-functional alignment and accountability
Create predictable, scalable feature launches that generate excitement internally and drive market differentiation
Partner with Product Management on discovery & pilot programs that validate feature value and gather early feedback
Messaging & Enablement
Develop compelling messaging and positioning for new features that clearly articulate value to technical and non-technical audiences alike
Ensure product knowledge is shared broadly across the organization through clear, accessible documentation
Partner with marketing peers to design and deliver enablement programs for Sales and Customer Success teams
Collaborate with Sales on demo flow design and updates that showcase product value
Develop and manage a process for ensuring all messaging, enablement, and other market-facing content is always up-to-date
Cross-Functional Partnership
Collaborate with Product, CS, and Marketing to drive adoption of new and existing capabilities
Work closely with Product and Product Design teams on UX iterations, bringing the customer and market perspective
Maintain a Voice of Customer program to inform product and messaging strategy
Help translate competitive intelligence and market insights back to Product teams
What Success Looks Like
Launch Excellence : Predictable, scalable feature launches that consistently generate excitement among internal teams and customers while driving clear market differentiation
Product Adoption : New features achieve strong adoption rates, demonstrating clear value delivery
Customer Impact : Contributions to improved renewal rates and expansion opportunities through better product understanding and positioning
Team Enablement : GTM teams are confident, well-informed product advocates who can articulate value clearly

Required Experience & Skills
5-7 years of Product Marketing experience in B2B SaaS or related go-to-market roles
Technical Collaboration : Proven experience working directly with technical teams, especially those building AI agents or complex technical products
Launch Track Record : Prior experience running cross-functional product launches from planning through execution
Exceptional Communication : Strong storytelling and writing skills with the ability to craft product marketing copy that drives differentiation, establishes voice, and clearly articulates value
Product Intuition : Natural ability to identify what drives value and to design a strategy and story that non-technical teams can understand and sell
Deep Product Partnership : Ability to become "mind-melded" with Product Managers, understanding their goals, priorities, risks, and what makes them tick
Collaboration Excellence : Skilled at framing product expertise into clear documentation and seamless hand-offs, particularly when enabling distributed teams
Customer-Centric : Deep customer obsession and empathy that informs all messaging and positioning decisions
Maker Mentality : Just as excited about creating the product as the Product Managers are—you find joy in the building process
Organizational Excellence : Highly organized and detail-oriented with a commitment to documenting everything clearly and accessibly

Prior work experience in martech, sales tech, enablement tech, or revenue operations companies
Experience thriving in a small, early-stage startup environment where you've worn multiple hats and moved quickly; or experience in a larger SaaS environment where you owned PMM for a full product lifecycle end-to-end or a full strategic product area
Understanding of how technical products are adopted and used in the field

Based in India with the ability to collaborate in real-time with US-based teams (overlap with East Coast mornings, approximately 8am-12pm EST)
Why This Role Matters
You'll be joining at a formative stage where your work will directly shape how we bring products to market and how our teams understand and sell our value. The messaging foundations you build, the processes you establish, and the partnerships you forge will scale with us as we grow. If you're energized by the opportunity to be a maker, a bridge-builder, and a storyteller all at once—and you thrive in the dynamic environment of an early-stage startup—we'd love to hear from you.
This role offers the opportunity to make an outsized impact on our go-to-market success while working with cutting-edge technology and a passionate, collaborative team.

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

s.h: We have expanded from voice into three main platforms
s.t:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

We are hiring our first partner marketer for ElevenAgents in North America. We are looking for someone who has built partner marketing programs at scale and knows what it looks like when it is done well.
ElevenAgents is already inside some of the world’s largest enterprises. The ecosystem is ready to move. The hyperscalers, AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft, are where a growing share of enterprise software now gets bought. The global and regional systems integrators are the firms actually delivering these deployments. What we do not have yet is anyone marketing that.
One week you are running a joint go-to-market program at an industry event with a technology partner, drawing on a shared MDF budget. The next you are working with a systems integrator to get ElevenAgents in front of the right enterprise buyers. You will define what partner marketing looks like at ElevenLabs, then build it: the programs, the playbooks, and the relationships.
The goal is to 11x the return we get from our partner relationships.

You have built partner marketing programs from scratch and know what 0 to 1 actually looks like in practice.
You have hands-on experience across co-marketing: joint campaigns, co-branded events, MDF management, and partner enablement.
You have run at least one hyperscaler or systems integrator relationship yourself, and can name it.
You know the mechanics. Cloud marketplaces, co-sell programs, MDF, partner tiers, and practice enablement. You can explain how the money moves and who has to say yes.
You understand what technology and SI partners need to go to market effectively, and how to make it easy for them to say yes.
You can build partner relationships on both sides of the table and earn trust quickly.
You know how to measure partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, and can translate that into something meaningful for leadership.
You set your own priorities and move without waiting to be asked.
You have 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, with at least 3 to 5 years in partner or channel marketing.
Bonus
Experience marketing AI agents, contact center technology, or developer tooling.
Experience launching a product into a category that did not exist yet.
Growth Potential
We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth.
Build the partner motion from 0 to 1, then build the team around it. North America is our largest market and this function will grow with it.
Go deep on the ecosystem and own alliances marketing across all three ElevenLabs platforms.
For those who want to go broader, there is a path to a B2B marketing leadership role as ElevenLabs scales in North America.
Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in North America with the ability to operate in PT or ET timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in New York or San Francisco.

At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.
We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.
To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.
Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.
If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.
Hiring Manager: Christy Poulos
Team: Product Marketing
Why This Role, Why Now
Braze is the leading customer engagement platform, helping the world's most ambitious brands build absolutely engaging relationships with their customers. Decisioning Studio is our set of products that decide what happens next for every customer, at scale, in the moment.
This is the most technically demanding product area in Product Marketing at Braze, and one of the most strategically consequential. Decisioning sits at the intersection of our data foundation and our AI capabilities — it's the product that makes both of them mean something to a customer. It competes in the fastest-moving corner of enterprise software, against a set of players that changes every quarter, in front of buyers who range from a CMO to a staff data engineer.
This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who wants depth over breadth. You will own Decisioning Studio including positioning, messaging, marketing plans, launch motion, competitive strategy, field narrative, and you'll do it as a peer to the PMMs who carry the rest of the Braze portfolio, helping shape the overarching narrative that connects it all.
What You'll Own
Decisioning Studio product marketing including positioning, messaging architecture, launch strategy and execution, competitive strategy, pricing and packaging input, and the field narrative. Every decision about how this product reaches the market runs through you.
Technical audience credibility. Own how Braze explains decisioning to data engineers, architects, platform owners, and technical evaluators. These are audiences that will not tolerate marketing that skates over how something actually works.
Competitive strategy for decisioning and AI-driven personalization. Know this competitive set cold, and turn that knowledge into positioning that wins deals rather than positioning that describes the market.
Your contribution to the Data & AI portfolio narrative. Decisioning Studio doesn't stand alone. You'll partner with the PMMs who own the Braze Data Platform, observability, Account Objects, Operator, and Agent Console to build the overarching story that explains why these products belong together.
Roadmap influence. Partner with Product Management and Engineering as a genuine strategic peer, bringing market and customer insight that shapes what gets built, not just how it gets announced.

Translate genuinely complex technology into language that lands. Decisioning logic, large language models, agentic systems, data infrastructure — you make hard things clear without making them shallow, and you adjust register for the room without losing substance.
Run launches that don't stop at the launch. Take Decisioning Studio releases from positioning through field readiness, and build the sustained motion that drives adoption and expansion on an ongoing basis, not just the moment of announcement.
Build and own the marketing plan for your products. You will partner with our demand, brand, and communication team members to build, execute, and measure every strategy and tactic.
Own pricing and packaging input. Partner with Pricing, Product, and Finance on how decisioning capabilities are packaged and monetized, and make sure the story holds together for customers and for the field.
Enable the field to sell a technical product with confidence. Partner with the PMM GTM team to build the narratives, plays, and assets that let Sales, Solutions Consulting, and CS support our customers and prospects.
Spend real time with customers and the market. Treat customer and analyst time as a priority, not a luxury, and bring what you learn back into positioning, enablement, and the roadmap conversation.
Act as a thought leader in the market. You write content, speak at events, and show up as a voice to listen to for marketers adopting AI in new ways. You are comfortable on stage, and an engaging writer.
Use AI as a practitioner, not a commentator. You market AI products and you use AI in your own work. You're credible on both because you actually do both.
Operate without direct authority. Get things shipped across Product, Engineering, Sales, Enablement, and Marketing by earning trust and building relationships, not by escalating.

Technically deep, and it shows. You can hold your own in an architecture conversation, ask an engineer a question that makes them think, and earn credibility with technical buyers on the substance of what you say.
Fluent in the enterprise AI landscape. Large language models, agentic AI, AI infrastructure, and the evolving ecosystem of AI tools and platforms — you follow this market closely and have real opinions about where it's going.
An exceptional writer. You write with clarity, precision, and edge, and you can compress something complicated into something sharp.
Comfortable with any audience. A technical deep-dive with a data engineering team, an executive briefing, an analyst inquiry, a sales kickoff stage.
Execution-focused. You have strategic range and a bias for shipping. Ideas that don't reach the market don't count.
A craftsperson who wants depth. You're drawn to owning one hard thing completely and you take pride in the quality of the work itself.
Steeped in martech. You understand this market, the competitive set, and how the role of marketing is being reshaped by AI and you can speak to that change with a point of view.
Data-driven. You instrument your programs, know what's working, and connect PMM work to pipeline and win rates with real numbers.
How Success Is Measured
Success is measured against business outcomes, not activity: pipeline influenced, Decisioning Studio adoption and expansion, competitive win rates, and the market's understanding of what Braze decisioning does and why it's different. You'll be expected to instrument your programs and show that connection clearly and consistently.
8+ years of Product Marketing experience, with an exceptionally strong background in technical and AI products.

About Faire
Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline.

At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores.

With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.
We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

Faire is building an AI-enabled talent organization, hiring the people shaping the future of personalized commerce for retailers and brands around the world. We're looking for a Talent Brand Manager to build our employer value proposition and turn it into one cohesive talent brand strategy across all of our digital surfaces: LinkedIn, our careers site, social, Glassdoor, and increasingly, the AI tools candidates now use to research and compare offers.
This is a hands-on, builder role. You'll shape Faire's EVP, then build the systems that carry it to our employees, like building AI tools that make it easy for employees to tell their own stories and put our leaders' voices in front of candidates.

You will also develop an AEO strategy that ensures Faire shows up as the clear, authentic answer when candidates ask LLMs to learn more about the company and compare offers. You'll give recruiters that same enablement, arming them with the narrative and objection-handling they need to authentically represent Faire in the market.
You'll report to Jenny Talwar, Head of Talent, and be based in San Francisco.

Architect our employer value proposition: Define a compelling "why Faire, why now" narrative tailored for key hiring areas, beginning with our Engineering, Product, Design, and Data teams. Highlighting the broad range of backgrounds of the retailers and brands we serve, so the workforce we build increasingly reflects the diversity and vibrancy of our customers.
Create a unified digital footprint: Orchestrate high-impact campaigns across LinkedIn, Glassdoor, and our careers site to ensure a consistent talent brand backed by measurable performance indicators.
Establish Answer Engine Optimization: Develop an AEO framework to ensure Faire’s culture and opportunities are accurately and prominently represented within LLMs.
Champion the talent brand identity: Act as a steward for our voice, ensuring every job description and candidate touchpoint aligns perfectly with Faire’s established brand guidelines.
Scalable storytelling: Establish a repeatable engine for surfacing authentic stories from our leaders and employees that showcase our values, incredible internal mobility stories, and give a real glimpse into life at Faire.
Empower the front line: Create a comprehensive self-serve toolkit for recruiters and hiring managers, including audience-specific positioning and narrative-driven objection handling.
Build AI-powered enablers: Launch internal tools that leverage AI to help every Faire employee transform their personal experiences into polished, social-ready content.
Measure and iterate: Rigorously track candidate sentiment and conversion data to evaluate the effectiveness of our talent brand investments on hiring success.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Marketing and Comms partners to ensure a seamless integration of our employer brand across the business.

5+ years building employer brand, talent marketing, or recruitment marketing programs, ideally from the ground up
Experience running a cohesive brand strategy across owned and earned digital channels: careers site, LinkedIn, social, and Glassdoor
Comfortable building self-serve, custom AI tools for individual and team use, and applying them to drive productivity and scale
Understands how AI-driven search and answer engines (AEO/GEO) shape how a brand's content surfaces, and wants to build that muscle for talent brand
Exceptional writer and editor, able to turn complex, cross-functional work into a story people remember
Experience building recruiter enablement materials, including objection-handling content
Uses data (candidate feedback, funnel metrics, brand perception) to prioritize what to build and prove it worked
Strong cross-functional partner, with experience working across Recruiting, Marketing, Comms, and People teams to ship projects

Integrate messaging into MEDDPICC and other sales methodologies.
Develop vertical messaging and industry-specific sales assets.
Build and maintain a centralized repository of GTM messaging, presentations, and commercialization assets.
Partner with field teams to continuously improve materials based on customer feedback.
Cross-Functional Leadership

Build repeatable GTM planning rhythms across organizations.
Help teams align around priorities, milestones, launch plans, and business outcomes.
Partner with Demand Generation to ensure campaigns reinforce Fleetio's value narrative.
Support partner commercialization through joint messaging, enablement, and go-to-market programs.
Building the Function
Establish the commercialization function at Fleetio.
Define operating processes, templates, and best practices.
Identify opportunities to scale through AI, automation, and repeatable systems.
Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing commercialization team as Fleetio grows.
Create an environment focused on experimentation, learning, ownership, and measurable business impact.

Deliveroo is looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Search and App to own two of our most important growth channels: paid search and app marketing across France, Italy and Belgium. You will set the strategy, own the budget, and lead the team responsible for turning media spend into profitable, sustainable growth.
This is a leadership role for someone who wants to build and run a high-performing performance marketing function inside a business that moves fast. Deliveroo operates in a dynamic, competitive market, and priorities shift quickly in response to what we learn. You will need to redirect budget, team focus, and strategy at short notice, sometimes across several markets or initiatives at once.
AI is central to how this role will be delivered. You will be expected to actively use and champion AI tools — from automated bidding and creative generation to forecasting and anomaly detection — to make the channel more efficient and to free up the team to focus on higher-value strategic work. Experience of applying AI in a marketing or growth context, or a genuine appetite to build that experience quickly, is essential.
You will operate within a matrix organisation, working alongside Brand, Growth, Product, Data Science, Finance, and regional General Managers. Success in this role depends on your ability to build trust and alignment across a wide group of stakeholders who do not report to you, and to keep them aligned even as plans change. This role will report into the Performance Marketing Director and work under our hybrid model - 3 days a week from our London HQ.
What you'll be doing
Own the strategy, execution, and performance of paid search (Google, Bing, and other search platforms) and app marketing across France, Italy and Belgium.
Deliver growth in New Customers, Resurrections, New Vertical purchases and subscriptions to our loyalty programme efficiently for the channel. Manage the team to deliver against them alongside reporting performance to senior marketing and business leadership.
Lead, coach, and grow a team of paid search and app marketing specialists, building the capability the team needs as the business and the channels evolve.
Identify, adopt, and scale AI-driven tools and automation across bidding, creative production, measurement, and anomaly detection to improve performance and efficiency.
Own budget allocation across paid search and app, and reallocate spend quickly in response to performance, competitor activity, or changes in the market.
Partner closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Analytics to build and refine attribution, measurement, and bidding models the team relies on.
Work as part of a matrix organisation, collaborating with Brand, Growth, Product, Finance, and regional General Managers to align a broad set of stakeholders around shared goals and trade-offs.
Track platform and policy changes across Google, Apple, and Android, and adapt Deliveroo's approach ahead of competitors.

Significant experience leading paid search and/or app marketing at scale, ideally in a high-growth consumer, marketplace, or on-demand business.

Own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for the full Elsevier Health Education portfolio — both existing products and new launches.

Build the sales enablement toolkit: collateral, case studies, competitive battle cards. Partner closely with Customer Success.
Define and report on the portfolio's marketing-influenced metrics: adoption, renewal, expansion, and student engagement.
Develop a narrative for Elsevier Health Education that is compelling to institutions, faculty, and students simultaneously.

12+ years of product marketing experience; 3+ years in a senior leadership role with direct reports.
Strong background in healthcare education, edtech, or professional learning — you understand how academic institutions buy and how learners engage.
Proven ability to build differentiated positioning in competitive, content-rich categories.
Experience working across both institutional B2B and individual B2C marketing motions.
Strong cross-functional operating instincts — comfortable partnering with Product, Sales, and Business Unit leadership.
Exceptional written storytelling; able to craft a narrative that resonates with deans and a second-year nursing or medical student simultaneously.
Track record of launching products in education technology or professional development markets.

Experience with US and international markets.

Quarterly Strategic Planning : Develop quarterly and annual promotional roadmaps aligned with commercial priorities, seasonal opportunities, and market dynamics.
Budget Ownership : Manage and report campaign-level budgets, tracking spend against target and flagging when a promotion's ROI or margin impact is off plan.
Customer-centric Programmes : Partner with Data Science to translate customer and performance data into promo mechanics that are genuinely relevant, not just discounted.
Performance Optimization : Own weekly reporting on in-flight campaign performance and lead post-campaign analysis to identify what worked, what didn't, and what's worth testing next.
Promotional Analytics : Analyze price elasticity and discount depth mechanics by running structured tests to find the minimum effective discount.
Test & Learn Agenda : Design and run local test-and-learn experiments, feeding results back into the broader promotional strategy.
Competition Monitoring : Keep on top of competitor trends and market activity to keep our offers sharp and well-positioned.
Commercial Business Cases : Build business cases with financials for scaling a successful test into a recurring, budgeted promotional mechanic.
Customer Advocacy : Champion the consumer voice, ensuring every promotion offers genuine value rather than just a lower price.
Stakeholder Communication : Translate complex datasets into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.
